lifecycle.mount: Build-time composition into shared/shell.html, before scripts execute.
lifecycle.initialize: Page-owned kraneInit_* routines are called once by shared/runtime.js in dependency order. Do not call again on each route change.
lifecycle.activate: Shared show() changes active screen and emits krane:screenchange. Page functions respond through shared router or their registered listeners.
lifecycle.unmount: Not supported during a running session. Existing shared handlers retain DOM references; keep templates mounted until the app is disposed.

behavior.note: Page-specific functions, rendering and lifecycle are in page.js; cross-page state/services and generic components remain shared.

externalDependencies: Shared CSS, icons, select enhancement, i18n and store adapters; see shared/shell.html and page-ownership-inventory.json. Page-specific external renderers are now page-owned.
productionBoundary: Prototype auth/storage/payment are demonstrations. Replace via agreed backend contracts; do not accept browser flags as authorization.
